description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarLoggerHandler, which integrates Monolog logging library with the application's LoggerManager. It provides a custom logging handler that converts Monolog log records into the format expected by the LoggerManager and writes them accordingly.

classes.name: SugarLoggerHandler
classes.description: A custom Monolog handler that routes log messages to the application's LoggerManager, converting log levels as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles writing log records by sending formatted messages to LoggerManager at the appropriate level.

methods.name: psrToSugarLevel
methods.description: Converts Monolog PSR log levels (numeric) to LoggerManager string levels.
